description: Fix loading and state defects in primary-advantage: stuck skeletons, hydration mismatch on games, unbounded article scroll, admin search storm, render-body components, and hardcoded Thai lookups.
deviation_notes: All 12 FRs done plus residuals. Second pass 2026-09-13: six message keys used by FR-2 error/empty states were missing in all five locales (WordList.loadError, WordList.empty, Components.loadError, Components.emptyList, Lesson.SentenceActivities.loadError, Lesson.SentenceActivities.retry) — added to en/th/cn/tw/vi; nine render tests that mocked next-intl as identity were converted to a shared real-messages provider (render-with-messages helper), so missing keys now fail tests. Characterization tests keep identity mocks deliberately to pin keys during merges.
